name: Gulf Partnership Project Assistance Fund and North Florida Capacity Fund

funder.name: Partnership for Gulf Coast Land Conservation

summary: Grants of up to USD 50,000 that pay land trusts for the due-diligence work behind land and conservation-easement deals (appraisals, title, surveys, baseline studies, closings), plus a North Florida fund for land conservation project staff. Applicants must be Gulf Partnership members.

geography.label: Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas

reporting: A progress report about six months after the award and a final report within 30 days of completion.

status.quote: The Gulf Partnership is now accepting PAF Proposals.

applicant_types.quote: The Project Assistance Fund is a matching grant program available to land trusts across the Gulf States

geography.quote: The project is located within the Gulf States of Alabama, Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi, or Texas

access.quote: The Gulf Partnership is now accepting PAF Proposals.

amount.quote: may receive subawards of up to $50,000 to complete appraisals, appraisal reviews, title exams, environmental and baseline studies, surveys, closings, and other due diligence necessary for conservation activity.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants are not required to provide match.

window.quote: Request for Proposals can be submitted anytime throughout the year and will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

reporting.quote: A semi-annual report will be due approximately 6-months after the award, and the completed form will be due 30 days after the completion of the project.
